info.name: The Things Stack — Application Server AppAs GatewayAccess API
info.description:
The Things Stack is an open-source LoRaWAN Network Server implementation. This OpenAPI was derived from the upstream gRPC-Gateway generated api.swagger.json published by TheThingsNetwork/lorawan-stack v3.36.

Contact Support:
 Name: The Things Industries

item.name:
Update the rights of an API key of the gateway.
This method can also be used to delete the API key, by giving it no rights.
The caller is required to have all assigned or/and removed rights.
